simple.meaning: גָּדַל (gâdal) appears 116 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Joshua, Judges, and 17 more, beginning at Genesis 12:2. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as flock, mountain, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּדַל (H1431) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גָּדַל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גָּדַל (gâdal) / H1431 is tracked through Genesis 12:2, Genesis 19:13, Genesis 19:19, Genesis 21:8. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H1431. gadal גָּדַל 115 verb grow up, become great (Aramaic גְּדַל (Ithpe`el), twist, twine , Arabic twist a cord, make firm, strong, become strong , so Late Hebrew) — Qal Perfect ׳ג etc. Gen 38:14 14 t.; suffix גְּדֵלַנִי Job 31:18 ; Imperfect יִגְדַּל etc. Psa 35:27 34t.; — 1 grow up , a. child Gen 21:8 , 20 ; 25:27 ; 38:11 , 14 ; Exod 2:10-11 , (JE) Judg 11:2 ; 13:24 ; Ruth 1:12 ; 1Sam 2:21 ; 3:19 ; 1Kin 12:8 , 10 ( = 2Chr 10:8 , 10 ) 2Kin 4:18 ; כְאָב גְּדֵלַנִי he grew up to me as to a father Job 31:18 ; b. lamb 2Sam 12:3 . 2 become great , a. in extent, wealthy Gen 26:13 (twice in verse); 41:40 (JE) Jer 5:27 ; b. in value . בְּעֵינָ֑י נֶפֶשׁ גָָּֽדְלָה י, ׳בְּעֵינֵי prized by 1Sam 26:24 (twice in verse); c. in intensity, grief Job 2:13 , mourning Zech 12:11 , punishment Lam 4:6 , trespass Ezek 9:6 ; d. in sound, loud cry Gen 19:13 (J); e. in importance, of a king Eccl 2:9 ; 1Kin 10:23 ( = 2Chr 9:22 ) Dan 8:9-10 , (under figure of horn), chief Gen 24:35 ; 48:19 (J), Messiah Micah 5:3 , Jerusalem Ezek 16:7 ; f. of God 2Sam 7:22 ; Psa 104:1 , his works 92:6 , his power Num 14:17 (J). 3 to be magnified , a. house of David Zech 12:7 ; b.
